name: see-veo
title: Personal CV / Resume
description: Personal CV and resume as an installable Progressive Web App with PDF export.
audience: Potential employers, clients, and collaborators reviewing the developer’s work — anyone who wants a quick, clear picture of skills and output without asking for a PDF.
useCases: A recruiter receives a link in an application — sees skills, projects, and live commit activity in one page without downloading anything
A potential client wants proof of consistent output — checks the embedded activity charts showing commit history across real projects
An interviewer needs a printable CV for a panel review — saves the page as PDF directly from the browser
A collaborator bookmarks the site as a PWA — can pull it up offline during a meeting to reference project details

dataPrivacy.storage: Static site with no user data collection.
dataPrivacy.thirdParty: Embeds repo-tor charts via iframe. Contact form sends to tool-till-tees API.
